QF.id: III-C Prevention of Money Laundering Act_3

question.text: For certain offences specified in Paragraph 2 of Part A of the Schedule to PMLA, the imprisonment may extend to:

explanation.text: The Logic: For proceeds of crime related to offences specified in Paragraph 2 of Part A of the Schedule to PMLA, the imprisonment shall not be less than 3 years and may extend to 10 years (NISM-Series-III-C workbook, p.160). The Trap: The general PMLA ceiling of 7 years on p.160 applies to other money laundering offences; the 10-year ceiling is specific to Paragraph 2, Part A. Note: Pair the 10-year ceiling specifically with Paragraph 2 of Part A from p.160 rather than treating it as a generic enhanced provision.
